name: web-forager
description: Clean-room, robots-aware web intelligence for academic research. Search 360/Bing/Sogou, fetch HTML/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/EPUB/CSV and RSS/Atom, extract metadata and tables, discover sitemaps, query arXiv/Crossref/PubMed/DOI, stream Markdown chunks, cache politely, and let an agent surf the web or Bilibili with resumable sessions. Ships a CLI, an OpenCLI-style --agent envelope and a stdio MCP server. Optional Playwright rendering.
disclaimer: 本插件仅供学术研究使用。使用者需遵守目标网站的 Terms of Service 及相关版权法律。禁止用于抓取个人隐私数据或进行恶意并发攻击。
